title: Sunpak Platinum Plus FlexPodDX Tabletop Tripod - New, Sealed
descriptionText: The Sunpak Platinum Plus FlexPodDX Tabletop Tripod is a compact and versatile tripod designed for gimbals and cameras. Made of polycarbonate, it features adjustable legs, automatic lock, and rubber feet for stability. With a folded length of 7.5 inches and a maximum height of 5.5 inches, this tripod also has a two-way ball head for flexible positioning. Ideal for tabletop photography, it comes sealed in its packaging.
